fixtures.preview: A Roses clash at Elland Road (midnight Sunday into Monday in Sydney), with United 13th and looking for only their second league win of the season.
talking_points: United are 13th after six games (one win, three draws, two defeats) and haven't won in the league since August.
Kobbie Mainoo and Luke Shaw are doubtful after fresh setbacks in the Spurs draw, and Shaw missed the Atlético trip.
Noussair Mazraoui has resumed training and Michael Carrick says he could be involved; Benjamin Sesko has a shin problem and is still being checked.
Patrick Dorgu (hamstring, weeks), Manuel Ugarte (ACL, back in 2027) and Tom Heaton are out.

fixtures.preview: United's first competitive meeting with Cesc Fàbregas's Como, who finished fourth in Serie A last season, on matchday 3.
talking_points: Como press high and were praised for their Champions League debut, with Fàbregas insisting they will keep attacking.
Former United academy defender Willy Kambwala plays for Como.
United's Leeds injury list will decide who is fit for a midweek trip.

fixtures.preview: A Sunday home game against Bournemouth, moved from Saturday for UK TV.
A lunchtime trip to Stamford Bridge with a 12:30pm UK start.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford.
Sydney's first game since Friday's 0-0 derby draw, a Sunday-afternoon doubleheader with the women's match at 5:45pm.
talking_points: Sydney drew 0-0 with the Wanderers and didn't have a shot on target until the 91st minute, so goals are the question.
They have kept 13 clean sheets since the start of last season, the most in the league.
Sydney are winless in seven at Allianz Stadium (five draws, two losses), including the last three league games there.
Jake Hollman, Oriola Sunday and Takahiro Sekine all made their A-League debuts for the club in the derby; no injuries were reported.

fixtures.preview: A 5pm Halloween game at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's official home opener.
A Friday-night home game against the Mariners.
An away trip to Brisbane Roar at Kayo Stadium in matchweek 5.
